name: io.github.djs-andorra/djs-andorra
title: DJs Andorra
description: Electronic music parties in Andorra: what's on tonight, this weekend and later, with DJs and venues.

tools.name: whats_on_tonight
tools.description: Parties in Andorra tonight (the current night in Andorra time), with venue, DJs and each party's djs.ad link.

town.description: Town or parish, for example "Canillo", "Soldeu" or "Pas de la Casa". Accents and case are ignored.

dj.description: A DJ's name or djs.ad slug.

tools.name: this_weekend
tools.description: Parties from Friday to Sunday: this weekend, or the next one when asked from Monday to Thursday.

town.description: Town or parish, for example "Canillo", "Soldeu" or "Pas de la Casa". Accents and case are ignored.

dj.description: A DJ's name or djs.ad slug.

tools.name: search_parties
tools.description: Coming parties in Andorra, filtered by night range, town, DJ, venue or free text. Soonest first.

from.description: First night to include, YYYY-MM-DD (Andorra nights).

town.description: Town or parish, for example "Canillo", "Soldeu" or "Pas de la Casa". Accents and case are ignored.

dj.description: A DJ's name or djs.ad slug.

q.description: Free text matched against party name, venue, town and DJs.

tools.name: get_party
tools.description: Full details of one party by its id (from another tool), or its djs.ad/festes/<name-and-night> link.

id.description: The party id, or its djs.ad page link.
